-上下文模拟难度高：不仅需要确保各类上下文信息（车辆状态、感知信息、记忆数据）之间逻辑自洽，还需要保证上下文与用户的提问内容完全匹配；
-上下文会影响预期结果：不同的上下文会使得同一个query的最佳预期不一样；
-多轮对话中上下文实时更新：评测时，上下文信息需要随着多轮对话的推进而动态变化，无法沿用固定不变的静态数据进行测试。",{"fileToken":"Gj2vbdQQyoUieHx73CFchx3ynSh","height":574,"link":"https://internal-api-drive-stream.larkoffice.com/space/api/box/stream/download/v2/cover/Gj2vbdQQyoUieHx73CFchx3ynSh/?height=1280&mount_node_token=AWdQsvKFLh6CiMtzjJZcz5RLndg&mount_point=sheet_image&policy=equal&width=1280","text":"","type":"embed-image","width":1330},{"category":"at-user-block","en_name":"Ruiting Chen","link":"https://s3-imfile.feishucdn.com/static-resource/avatar/v3_00tu_d83a79e8-64c0-451e-bb10-9d36234e7adg_64.webp","mentionNotify":false,"mentionType":0,"name":"陈芮婷","not_notify":false,"text":"@陈芮婷","token":"7524153300070694940","type":"mention"},null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null],["主动服务如何评测","主动服务评测难点：
